description: A rooted predatory fungus that resembles an ordinary large mushroom until several long whip-like tendrils lash from its body. Rooted fungal stalk with cap and exactly four long flexible tendrils emerging around the upper stalk. Simple cap and stalk with sparse spots; tendrils smooth and uncluttered. Thick mushroom stalk and cap with multiple long narrow tendrils extending outward in sweeping curves.
